names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 29 Ιουλίου, «Άγιος Θεοδόσιος ο Νέος (ή Μικρός) ο Ευσεβής Βασιλιάς», with the rank words and the bynames left off. The page gives the two bynames together, ο Νέος and ο Μικρός, and says the second was given him so that he should be told apart from his grandfather the Great.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 29ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Θεοδόσιος ο Νέος (ή Μικρός) ο Ευσεβής Βασιλιάς»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. This is Theodosius II, not the corpus's Theodosius the Great, whose Greek row is 17 January and whose page gives him 346–395: the head line here reads «Αγιος Θεοδοσιος ο Νεος (η Μικρος) ο Ευσεβης Βασιλιας (401 - 450)», and the notice makes him the son and heir of Arcadius, crowned in 408 at seven years old, and the emperor who convoked the Third Ecumenical Council at Ephesus in 431. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).

birth.note: saint.gr's head line: «Αγιος Θεοδοσιος ο Νεος (η Μικρος) ο Ευσεβης Βασιλιας (401 - 450)». The notice itself gives no year of birth, only that he took the sceptre in 408 at seven years old.

death.note: saint.gr's head line: «Αγιος Θεοδοσιος ο Νεος (η Μικρος) ο Ευσεβης Βασιλιας (401 - 450)». The notice gives no account of his death at all; this is the second year of the head line.
